howItWorks.title: From brief to installed draping

steps.title: Event details
steps.description: Date, venue, guest count, and event type — wedding, corporate, gala, or mitzvah.

steps.title: Drape goal
steps.description: What you want to achieve — backdrop, perimeter, room dividers, stage masking, or full transformation.

steps.title: Measurements / floor plan
steps.description: Room dimensions or a venue floor plan to scope pipe and drape, height, and coverage.

steps.title: Fabric and color
steps.description: Drape style, color, fullness, and texture preferences for your event atmosphere.

steps.title: Add-ons
steps.description: Star drape, blackout zones, step-and-repeat, uplighting surrounds, and specialty elements.

steps.title: Review and submit
steps.description: Confirm your setup and request a final event drape rental estimate from our team.
